title: Bruce Maccabee judged the ARV photographs hoaxes

tellings.quote: I don't remember Bruce mcabe looked at them I know Bruce mcabe had only said um they definitely looked like hoaxes to him

plain: The UFO photo analyst Bruce Maccabee is said to have judged a set of ARV photographs to be fakes. ARV stands for "alien reproduction vehicle", a supposed human-built craft copied from alien designs. The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels he does not remember whether Maccabee actually examined the pictures, only that Maccabee had said "they definitely looked like hoaxes to him."
